name: orc-stone-01
description: Stone-01 HO Notice Assistant — implementation repository (bootstrap only)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @orc/shared && npm run build -w @orc/api && npm run build -w @orc/web
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @orc/shared && npm run dev -w @orc/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @orc/shared && npm run start:dev -w @orc/api
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @orc/shared && npm run lint -w @orc/shared && npm run lint -w @orc/api && npm run lint -w @orc/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @orc/shared && npm run test -w @orc/shared && npm run test -w @orc/api && npm run test:integration -w @orc/api && npm run test -w @orc/web && npm run test:root
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @orc/shared && npm run typecheck -w @orc/shared && npm run typecheck -w @orc/api && npm run typecheck -w @orc/web
